text:
Clara Zhou: Heads-up from support 1: customer migrated and their similarity search regressed. Quick repro: quickstart embed call without model param returned 128d instead of expected 1536d.
Jon Park: Oof. We didn't call out the v1 alias -> fallback mapping in the migration doc.
Mina Rao: Immediate fixes: 1) Update quickstart snippets to pin embed model ids. 2) Add a bold migration note about alias fallthrough and vector dims. 3) Add a lightweight docs smoke test to verify embed length.
Clara Zhou: Proposed snippet change (JS): `await client.embed({ model: 'h2o-embed-1536', input: 'hello' })` and equivalent Python.
Jon Park: I'll swap snippets in the quickstart PR and mention "pin model IDs to avoid dimensionality surprises" in the inline comment.
Mina Rao: I'll draft the migration paragraph and a banner copy: "Verify embedding model and vector dimensionality after swaps; pin model IDs in production."
Clara Zhou: Raj from infra suggested a non-blocking smoke job that asserts vector length but only triggers warnings unless a docs-owner label is present. Good compromise.
docs-bot: Issue created: "docs: migration - embed alias dimensionality note" (#5234)
ci-bot: Queued smoke job `docs-embed-length-check`
ci-bot: Smoke job completed: WARN (expected 1536, got 1536) - no action required
Jon Park: PRs opened: quickstart snippet (WIP), migration note (draft). I'll tag Mina for review.
Mina Rao: Review complete. Merging once CI smoke is green.
Clara Zhou: After merge: add changelog bullet and update support canned response. I'll handle comms.
Jon Park: Merged snippets and added unit examples for TS/Py.
Mina Rao: Migration page updated and banner added. Closing loop. Thanks all.
